Context: TIME-SCHEDULE FOR ONLINE GENERATION AND RECORDING OF APAR FOR THE YEAR 2022-23

16. If a reporting officer has failed to initiate action to complete APAR before 30th June of the year in which the financial year ended, he forfeits his right to enter any remarks in the APAR and should submit all APARs to the Reviewing Officer on the next day. Similarly, the Reviewing Officer forfeits his right to enter any remarks in APAR beyond 31st August of the year in which the financial year ended.
